origin.observation: The two iron-57 level records retain the measured or evaluated population half-life alongside its derived mean lifetime.

operation.calculation: Divide the population half-life and its reported uncertainty by ln(2) in consistent units, then evaluate the existing constant-hazard survival kernel.

limits: The half-life must describe the total population of the prepared state. A branch-specific rate or driven loss does not establish that input. Mean lifetime and half-life representations of one measurement supply one evidence family.
